svg.aria-label: Detection pipeline: the Cisco network, OPNsense and Suricata, the Windows domain, Proxmox and Docker, and UniFi send logs to Wazuh, shown as a virtual machine that decodes, correlates and responds, then forwards events to Splunk, also a virtual machine, for search and dashboards. A brute force on DC-01 is caught, Wazuh raises a level 10 alert and an active response blocks the source.
svg.title: Detection pipeline
